prior_summary: Predict local SE(3) corrections and compose each executed slot with the fresh measured TCP to tolerate modest feasible arm-entry and tracking deviations.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when drawer/red geometry is near demonstrated support but TCP pose, measured joints or tracking lag differs modestly, including a predecessor-produced intermediate entry. Relations must remain coherent; this is not arbitrary recovery.
termination_guidance: Switch after drawer_position exceeds 0.26 m and stabilizes; nominal robust transfer also observes handle release and red/TCP upward co-motion after closure. Replan if local increments accumulate without expected progress.
limitations: Local corrections can drift and do not create invariance to large object displacement. They cannot infer contact truth or recover missed pulls/drops. Large offsets, collisions, singularities and joint-limit configurations remain unsupported.
